- chore: changelogs
- fix: ignore recipe check from apotheosis

- * Rest of the issues

- Add Turkish quest translation (#4294)
- * Add Turkish quest translation
- * Rework Turkish localization and fix QA issues
- * Fix Forbidden Arcanus and update SNBT files
- * fix: improve Turkish quest translations
- Blacklist Ore Hammers from Eternal Stella and allow Bone Keys to reset Trial Vaults (#4301)
- * Blacklist Ore Hammers from Eternal Stella
- The time has come.
- * Allow Bone Keys to reset Trial Vaults
- I also considered removing Decrepit Key from the trial vault reset tag, considering Iron's Spellbooks added its own item to reset Trial Vaults (the Tincture of Forgetfulness), but I ultimately decided on staying consistent with the Repeatable Trial Vaults mod
- PAINT THE TOWN RED: Added quests for Neo Vitae (#4302)
- * PAINT THE TOWN RED: Added quests for Neo Vitae
- * Updated Neo Vitae logo
- A few Quest Changes (#4303)
- * Shield of Retaliation Quest
- Plus update Relics quest to new format
- * Nerf XP Rewards for Spawner Upgrade Runes
- I unintentionally set it to XP Levels instead of XP
- * Iron's Spellbooks Quest Update
- - Adjustments to Dead King's quest
- - Added quest for Ominous Dead King
- - Slight adjustment to Cinderous Soulcaller's quest
- - Added "JOIN US" to the Cultist Outfit's quest
- - Fixed "Cryomancecr Outfit" typo
- Keep robit from Amber bees and Ars containment jar (#4304)
- Fix Ice and Fire configs (#4307)
- Reduce cobblestone and netherrack output from the ATM drills (#4309)
- This matches the output reductions implemented in MI 2.2.27 for MI's own copper and gold drills.
- Update Announcements (#4313)
- * Drop too old news
- * Correct News: removing Eternal Starlight was canceled
- Disallow sorting in Expanded AE terminals (#4320)
- Fixes #3852
- fix: make blood more compatible with other mods
- Closes #4296
- Closes #4297
- fix: remove material book on spawn
- fix: disable sus recipe on supplementaries
- fix: fix tag
- fix: FD and supplementaries integration
- feat: add neovitae item to star
- feat: neovitae configs
